scope: Read-only source allocation analysis, not an observed crash stack or numerical verdict.

KV_growth.mechanism: Allocate and copy all new layer K/V buffers while all old buffers stay alive; publish/release only after every layer succeeds. CpuBuffer zero-initializes vector-backed allocation.
KV_growth.reachable_boundary: First appended token after16384 enters block128 and grows128->133 blocks. options.kv_backed defaultsfalse.
KV_growth.causality_limit: Exceeds old6GiB cap independently of scratch if reached. Consistent with observed rise, but no flushed token/stage marker or stack establishes the failed v1 position.

other_owners.bound: Attention score buffer n_head*sequence floats shared across heads, reused per query, not per-thread quadratic history. At16heads and16895tokens about1.031MiB logical size; std::vector capacity can retain growth slack.
Prompt dequant scratch4*nin floats per worker; at maxnin3072,48KiB/thread (96KiB for2threads). No whole-model dequant cache.
Fallback local one-row dequant vector nin floats, released each dot; applies to generic decode. No retained per-row model cache.

Prefill arena512rows and one output-logit row; remains reused. Qwen slot widths for E1024,Q2048,KV1024,FF3072 sum17408 floats/row =>34MiB arena, no16384*vocab allocation. One151936-vocab F32 logits row about0.58MiB.
ExplicitF32 bypasses BF16 dtype scratch and block-int16 activation packing. Q5_K F32 head uses fused row dot, not full matrix expansion.

minimal_next_diagnostic_if_retry_fails: Do not modify current retry. In a fresh isolated probe only, flush stderr markers before/after prefill and each forced step with scored position, Model::kv_allocated_bytes()/kv_peak_bytes(); retain existing cgroup memory.current/peak/events and add memory.stat anon/file categories. Peak accounting updates only after successful growth, so a killed growth may never publish its modeled peak. No runtime flag or arithmetic change required.
current_retry: Parent reports4threads/10GiB active; no prediction of completion from allocation bound alone.
qualification: Source-derived memory requirement only. The bounded 10 GiB CPU retry is running; no CPU depth pass or exact v1 crash location is inferred.
